findings.text: follow-on: caller_environment and CALLER_PATH_ENV (lines 70-90) are copied verbatim from reckon/worker_git_shim.py:89-108; both modules already import reckon/shim_lookup.py, the stdlib-only helper the shims load first and the natural shared home for this plumbing, so the two copies must now be kept in step by hand and diverge silently on the same defect.

follow-on: the bootstrap re-adds the caller's PYTHONPATH to the shim interpreter's own sys.path after reckon's site-packages, so the interpreter does not strictly keep "only reckon's import root on its path" as the deliverable states; ordering still protects reckon's own packages (the negative control reddens only when the append precedes), but a module present only in the caller's directory becomes importable inside the shim process. The same bootstrap is in reckon/host_shims/salloc:67, sbatch:67 and srun:67.
